stories.headline: SoftBank breaks ground on $33B 10-GW data center and gas plant on former Ohio uranium site

key_facts.fact: The U.S. Department of Energy on Friday March 20 announced a public-private partnership with SoftBank and AEP Ohio to build a 10-gigawatt AI data center and up to 10 GW of new power generation, including 9.2 GW of natural gas, on the former Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site in Pike County, Ohio.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Department of Energy on Friday announced a partnership between Japan's SoftBank Group and electric utility AEP to build a colossal gas-fired power plant and data center on federal land in Ohio.

key_facts.fact: The investment totals $33.3 billion from Japan, forming the first phase of a $550 billion U.S.-Japan trade and investment agreement struck in October. SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son said the facility would be 'the center of our super-intelligence' and committed to not raising local electricity bills.
key_facts.excerpt: 'This is the center of our super-intelligence,' said Masayoshi Son, chairman and CEO of SB Group Corp. 'I will commit right now: We will not raise the electricity bills. But we will generate the entire energy we need in computers by ourselves.'

key_facts.fact: The Portsmouth site was used for Cold War uranium enrichment and has been undergoing decontamination for decades at a cost of billions. The DOE is rebranding it as the 'PORTS Technology Campus.' Construction and demolition workers at the site applauded the announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: The Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant in Pike County — now being branded as the 'PORTS Technology Campus' — is expected to include a 10-gigawatt data center and up to 10 gigawatts of new power generation.

key_facts.fact: If constructed, the gas plant and data center would each be among the world's largest. One gigawatt can power nearly 1 million homes, meaning the facility's 10 GW capacity is equivalent to roughly nine nuclear reactors. The heads of the U.S. Departments of Energy and Commerce attended the groundbreaking.
key_facts.excerpt: Planned 10-gigawatt SoftBank data center in Ohio might be the largest in the world — will require a $33 billion natural gas plant, equivalent to nine nuclear reactors.

stories.headline: Joliet approves $20B AI data center campus after marathon public hearings and 8-1 vote

key_facts.fact: The Joliet City Council voted 8-1 on Thursday March 20 to approve an annexation agreement for the 795-acre 'Joliet Technology Center,' a $20 billion AI data center campus led by developer PowerHouse Data Centers and parent Hillwood. It would become the largest data center in Illinois.
key_facts.excerpt: The Joliet City Council on Thursday approved a proposed $20 billion AI data center campus that would become the largest in Illinois, concluding weeks of debate marked by lengthy public opposition and a delayed vote earlier in the week.

key_facts.fact: The campus will consist of 24 two-story data center buildings spanning roughly 6.9 million square feet, built in four phases through 2032, with up to 1.8 gigawatts of power demand. It is located near Rowell and Bernhard roads southwest of Chicago.
key_facts.excerpt: The development, planned near Rowell and Bernhard roads southwest of Chicago, would consist of 24 two-story data center buildings spanning roughly 6.9 million square feet. Built in four phases through 2032, the campus is expected to reach up to 1.8 gigawatts of power demand.

key_facts.fact: A marathon public hearing on Monday stretched more than six hours, with dozens of residents voicing concerns over energy costs, water usage, noise, environmental effects, and farmland impacts. The meeting was recessed past midnight due to state rules prohibiting public meetings on election days.
key_facts.excerpt: The decision followed a marathon public hearing on Monday that stretched more than six hours, forcing officials to postpone the vote after dozens of residents voiced concerns over the project's environmental impact, energy use and proximity to homes.

key_facts.fact: The project is estimated to generate $2.1 billion in tax revenue over 30 years, including $310 million in property taxes, create 7,000-10,000 construction jobs and approximately 700 permanent positions. PJM Interconnection review found no power availability concerns.
key_facts.excerpt: Estimates suggest this project would create 7,000 - 10,000 new construction jobs, 700 permanent jobs, and $2 billion in property tax revenue over a 30-year span.

stories.headline: Unitree Robotics files for $610M Shanghai IPO after 335% revenue surge and 5,500 humanoids shipped

key_facts.fact: Chinese startup Unitree Robotics filed an IPO application on Friday March 20 on Shanghai's STAR Market, seeking to raise 4.2 billion yuan ($610 million). The Shanghai Stock Exchange accepted the application the same day, making it one of China's biggest domestic tech listings in years.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese startup Unitree Robotics on Friday filed an initial public offering application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, seeking to raise 4.2 billion yuan ($610 million), according to the prospectus, in a test of investor interest in humanoid robots.

key_facts.fact: The prospectus revealed 2025 revenue of 1.71 billion yuan, a 335% year-over-year increase. Adjusted net profit surged nearly eight times to 600 million yuan, with gross margins improving to 60.3% from 56.4% in 2024. Humanoid robots accounted for over half of revenue in the first nine months of 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Prospectus reveals that company's revenue jumped 335 per cent last year, while net profit surged nearly eight times to 600 million yuan.

key_facts.fact: Unitree shipped 5,500 humanoid robots in 2025, surpassing the combined output of all U.S. competitors including Tesla, Figure AI, and Agility Robotics, ranking first globally. In total, the company has delivered over 30,000 quadruped robots and more than 4,000 humanoids since 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree's robots were the star of Chinese state media's Spring Festival gala last month, which featured a technically ambitious martial arts sequence performed by over a dozen humanoid robots.

key_facts.fact: IPO proceeds will fund R&D into AI models for robotics, development of new products, and expansion of manufacturing facilities. The company was last valued at 12.7 billion yuan in a June 2025 funding round. Founder Wang Xingxing (born 1990) attended a symposium chaired by President Xi Jinping in February 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Funds allocated toward developing robot bodies, AI models and manufacturing facilities.

stories.headline: U.S. Army takes delivery of first autonomous-ready UH-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter

key_facts.fact: The U.S. Army announced on March 20 that it received its first UH-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter, extensively modified by Sikorsky (Lockheed Martin) to fly with or without a pilot in the cockpit. The aircraft was delivered to Fort Eustis, Virginia.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. Army officially received a groundbreaking H-60Mx Black Hawk helicopter, extensively modified to fly with or without a pilot at the controls.

key_facts.fact: The helicopter uses Sikorsky's MATRIX autonomy system and ALIAS kit (Aircrew Labor In-Cockpit Automation System), originally developed under a DARPA program over a decade ago. Mechanical flight controls were replaced with a fly-by-wire system, enabling ground-controlled autonomous operation.
key_facts.excerpt: The optionally-piloted helicopter — which has been designated UH-60Mx — will move into a 'rigorous testing phase' over the coming months.

key_facts.fact: The UH-60Mx is the primary testbed for the Army's Strategic Autonomy Flight Enabler (SAFE) program, which targets eventual integration of autonomous capabilities across hundreds of Black Hawks and future aircraft. The technology first demonstrated crewless flight in 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: By proving out this technology, the Army aims to unlock a new era of aviation. The delivery of this first optionally piloted vehicle Black Hawk is more than just a hardware handover; it's a tangible step toward a future where technology and soldiers work together.

key_facts.fact: A $6 million 2024 DARPA contract funded the integration of the MATRIX system onto the helicopter. Texas A&M University's Bush Combat Development Complex is also collaborating on autonomy testing for applications including wildland firefighting.
key_facts.excerpt: After years of successful demonstrations on both commercial and military aircraft, the technology has matured.

sources.title: U.S. Army Takes Major Leap into Future of Aviation with Delivery of First Autonomous-Ready Black Hawk

stories.headline: Northrop's Talon IQ drone flies first autonomous combat mission with Shield AI Hivemind

key_facts.fact: Northrop Grumman's Talon IQ modular testbed aircraft, equipped with Shield AI's Hivemind autonomous AI system, completed its first partner mission autonomy flight in Mojave, California. Hivemind successfully directed Talon IQ to execute combat air patrol and target engagement.
key_facts.excerpt: Northrop Grumman's Talon IQ modular testbed, equipped with Shield AI's Hivemind as its digital brain, has completed its first partner mission autonomy flight in Mojave, California.

key_facts.fact: The demonstration validated Talon IQ's plug-and-play architecture, which allows rapid integration of third-party autonomy systems while meeting US Government Reference Architecture standards. The aircraft swapped from Hivemind back to Northrop's Prism autonomy software during the same flight.
key_facts.excerpt: The demonstration validated the aircraft's plug-and-play design, which easily integrates third-party systems while meeting the standards of the US Government Reference Architectures.

key_facts.fact: Tom Jones, Corporate VP at Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems, said: 'By integrating Shield AI's Hivemind into our testbed, we've demonstrated an open architecture platform propelling plug and play mission autonomy forward at unprecedented speed.'
key_facts.excerpt: By integrating Shield AI's Hivemind into our testbed, we've demonstrated an open architecture platform propelling plug and play mission autonomy forward at unprecedented speed.

key_facts.fact: Hivemind has previously been validated on GA-ASI's MQ-20 Avenger and Airbus H145 helicopter, and was selected for integration into Anduril's YFQ-44A 'Fury' under the Air Force's Collaborative Combat Aircraft program.
key_facts.excerpt: Hivemind has been validated on GA-ASI's MQ-20 Avenger, Airbus H145 helicopter, and was selected for integration into Anduril's YFQ-44A 'Fury' under the Air Force's Collaborative Combat Aircraft program.

stories.headline: NASA reportedly plans to use SpaceX Starship to carry Orion to the Moon after Artemis V

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported that NASA is considering using SpaceX's Starship to transport the Orion capsule to the Moon, beginning after Artemis V. Under the plan, SLS would launch Orion to low Earth orbit, where it would rendezvous with Starship for the lunar journey.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA is reportedly considering using SpaceX's Starship to transport the Orion capsule to the Moon, with some sources calling it a done deal.

key_facts.fact: The Artemis schedule has been reshuffled by new NASA administrator Jared Isaacman, a former SpaceX customer. Artemis III is now a 2027 LEO test mission (analogous to Apollo 9), Artemis IV is set for a 2028 lunar landing, and Artemis V could follow the same year.
key_facts.excerpt: Artemis III is now a 2027 Low Earth Orbit mission to test lunar landing technology, with an actual landing pushed to Artemis IV in 2028 and Artemis V potentially following the same year.

key_facts.fact: The Space Launch System's future has grown increasingly uncertain. A Trump administration budget proposal suggested cancelling SLS after Artemis III before it was walked back. Using Starship as a lunar taxi would substantially reduce SLS's role or phase it out entirely after Artemis V.
key_facts.excerpt: The SLS has long been central to NASA's Artemis architecture, yet its future has grown increasingly uncertain. A budget proposal from the current administration suggested cancelling it after Artemis III.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX's Starship has not yet reached Earth orbit but has a next test flight scheduled for April 2026. The first Starship V3 variant features upgraded Raptor 3 engines and over 100-ton payload capacity to LEO, and is being prepared for launch from Starbase in south Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: The report demonstrates the fluid state of the Artemis program as managers work to develop solutions.

sources.title: Starship may chauffeur Orion to the Moon, as NASA mulls ditching SLS after Artemis V

stories.headline: Waymo publishes safety data showing 92% fewer serious crashes than humans across 170M miles

key_facts.fact: Waymo released new safety data covering 170.7 million 'rider-only' miles driven without a human behind the wheel across Phoenix, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Austin. The company reported 92% fewer crashes resulting in serious injury or worse compared to human benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: Waymo has released new safety data showing its driverless system has substantially lower crash rates than human drivers. The figures cover 170.7 million 'rider-only' miles driven without a human behind the wheel.

key_facts.fact: The data also showed 83% fewer crashes involving airbag deployment and 82% fewer crashes causing any injury. The analysis compares crash rates per mile rather than total incidents, using data reported under U.S. regulatory requirements.
key_facts.excerpt: Waymo vehicles were involved in 92% fewer crashes resulting in serious injury or worse compared with human benchmarks. The company also reported 83% fewer crashes involving airbag deployment and 82% fewer crashes causing any injury.

key_facts.fact: Waymo stated: 'The trust and safety of the communities where we operate is paramount to us. That's why we're voluntarily sharing our safety data. The data to date indicates the Waymo Driver is already making roads safer in the places where we currently operate.'
key_facts.excerpt: The trust and safety of the communities where we operate is paramount to us. That's why we're voluntarily sharing our safety data.

key_facts.fact: The safety report comes amid regulatory scrutiny: the California Gig Workers Union filed a complaint this week alleging Waymo is violating its state permit by transporting unaccompanied minors, and the CPUC is being asked to suspend Waymo's operating permit.
key_facts.excerpt: The complaint filed Tuesday alleges that Waymo is transporting unaccompanied minors in cities like San Francisco and Los Angeles, constituting a violation of the CPUC's conditions for autonomous vehicle cab services.
